title: Graph Beta: persist the current active graph projection
description: Graph Beta prerequisite for task-a9fd91c373c244c78df97945965a8038. Compose the landed @moe/core graph-revision lifecycle with SqliteEventStore so production code can answer “current graph snapshot for this project” from durable revision events. Measurement at HEAD a42ae2f1f9168d13b8b786404fc47b366cc8edd9: packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-{contract,reducer}.ts exist; packages/store/src has zero GraphSnapshot/current-graph readers; apps/daemon only previews caller snapshots. This task owns the durable projection/read seam only. The daemon graph command/query transport is a separate consumer task. Stage: GRAPH BETA per the design’s incremental-delivery boundary. Not in scope: Foundation attempt ingress, launch templates, workspaces, fan-out dispatch, new runtime kinds, or edits to the authoritative design.
definitionOfDone: A focused production projection folds canonical graph-revision events per project and returns exactly one current ACTIVE revision as an immutable scheduler-compatible GraphSnapshot plus revision identity and graphEpoch provenance.

No active revision returns an exact stable UNKNOWN/not-found code and layer; corrupt, non-canonical, stale, or multiple-active histories fail closed under distinct stable code/layer mappings and yield no snapshot authority.

Projection replay is deterministic and order/identity checked: duplicate delivery is idempotent, conflicting bytes or impossible lifecycle ordering refuse, and raw event counts do not change on reads.

Focused tests use a real SqliteEventStore, assert exact refusal code and layer, prove generated hostile-case counts are nonzero, and include one accepted active-graph control read from production events rather than a helper reimplementation.

The task names the daemon graph transport task as its real consumer and records that task id in completion evidence; pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test reports a nonzero executed-test count and pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck exits 0 for owned paths.
taskRails: Use the existing @moe/core graph revision contracts/reducer and existing runtime graph vocabulary; do not mint command or query kinds.
Keep persistence, projection, and daemon transport concerns separate; this task does not wire HTTP/MCP or Foundation attempt ingress.
Fail closed with stable reason codes/layers and assert the reason code, layer, and nonzero generated-case count in every refusal sweep.
Use TDD; target <=250 physical lines per production source and split before 400; preserve foreign shared-tree work and commit only explicit owned paths.
